summary: Extend the host-owned OAuth runtime with a bounded per-tenant host template (ADR-0108) and admit Shopify as a storefront connector on top of it.

impacts.evidence: The per-tenant OAuth host is resolved from the account's own tenant-scoped non-secret runtime config (connectorconfigrepo), the same store every runtime_config_template connector already uses; no cross-tenant host reuse is possible.
Shop domain is non-secret operational config, not PII; the OAuth access token remains behind the existing opaque SecretAccessor/UseSecret boundary with no new exposure.
oauth-start/oauth-callback request/response shapes are unchanged for every connector; no existing public HTTP/OpenAPI operation is removed or altered.
No EventBus schema is added or changed.

sdk.OAuth2Configuration gains four additive, opt-in fields (HostParameter/HostSuffix/ScopeSeparator/ExtraTokenParams); every existing OAuth2 connector's manifest is unchanged and Validate() takes the identical code path it always has when HostParameter is empty.
No schema change; the resolved host is read from the existing non-secret runtime-config store.

A resolved host must match a DNS-hostname shape, be strictly longer than HostSuffix, end with that exact literal suffix, and the fully-substituted URL is re-validated through the same validHTTPSURL check every fixed-host connector already passes through -- a tenant's own runtime config cannot redirect the OAuth flow outside the declared provider domain.

Shopify write capabilities remain gated by the existing payments.create-style capability checks (products.write/prices.write/inventory.write/orders.status.write); product create and webhook receipt are declared unsupported rather than faked.
Account OAuth start/complete audit actions are unchanged and reused verbatim; no new evidence shape is introduced.

Writes follow the existing fetch-compare-write-reconcile pattern (see docs/connectors/shopify/reconciliation.md); ambiguous transport failures reconcile against a re-fetch rather than retrying blindly.

Outbound authority is the resolved shop host and the fixed OAuth token endpoint only, both DNS-pinned through the existing SSRF-safe transport; inbound webhook receipt is explicitly unsupported in this task (see capability-audit.md), not silently unverified.
Non-2xx responses and malformed bodies are normalized to bounded errors; Shopify's leaky-bucket rate limit is respected via a conservative MinIntervalMS.
Shopify can be disabled by removing its connector accounts; the OAuth runtime extension is inert for every other connector, so no coordinated rollback is required.

New connectorauth/sdk unit tests cover host template resolution, suffix bounding, and scope-separator behavior; provider tests, go build/vet/test and the Task-064 conformance candidate pass 12 of 13 checks -- sandbox_isolation could not be exercised because this execution environment cannot create unprivileged Linux user namespaces, an environment constraint shared by every connector's Task-029 probe. docs/connectors/shopify/conformance-report.json records this genuine result rather than a fabricated pass.
